The method / Visualize the business / Step 1
ACTION 09 OF 32 · PHASE 03

Sketch the customer journey

Make the customer interaction tangible.

WHEN TO DO THISAfter a promising research gap; before writing production code.ESTIMATED WORK TIME30 min
↗
Your one job

Make the customer interaction tangible.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Map arrival → understanding the offer → trust → choosing a service → enquiry or checkout → confirmation.

  2. 02

    Identify the single most important CTA and what the visitor needs before clicking.

  3. 03

    Sketch a one-page landing page for a simple offer; do not add dashboards, admin roles or payment integrations yet.

  4. 04

    Write what you want to learn from showing the preview to customers.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Based on my attached business brief, write a mobile-first landing-page specification, not the full app. The page must explain the offer, customer benefit, real proof available, how it works, FAQs and one primary CTA. Avoid made-up photos, results, prices or testimonials. Include the exact mobile user journey and 5 questions for a preview test.
03

Finish with this

A concise mobile-first site brief with page sections, CTA and one test question.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • One primary CTA
  • No fake proof
  • The main offer is understandable in 5 seconds
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Building a beautiful website without understanding the purchase action.

READY TO MOVE ON?

A customer can understand the offer and find the next action on mobile without explanation.
